The '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their elongated heads, with four [[Color/Legends|dark]]<ref name="CW21" /> or yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Spy Girls" /> as well as a cluster of tendrils dangling from the bottoms of their faces.<ref name="CW21" /> They also possessed serrated, [[Claw/Legends|claw]]-like [[Limb/Legends|hands]], and green pigmentation.<ref name="Spy Girls" /> At least one member of this species was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CW21" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 6">{{FactFile2014|6|22 BBY 75-80|Dark Side Influence}} dates the [[Hunt for the Decimator]], the [[Dark Reaper crisis]], the [[First Battle of Kamino]], the [[battle of Ohma-D'un]], the [[battle of Pengalan IV]], ''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'', and the events of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' up until the [[Battle of Hypori]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in that order.</ref> while another visited [[Bezz Drexx's tower]] around the same time during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Spy Girls" />

==Behind the scenes==
